questions.stem: What is a quadrat used for in ecology?

options.text: Measuring the temperature of a habitat
Sampling the number or distribution of organisms in a defined area

questions.explanation: A quadrat is a square frame (usually 0.5m x 0.5m or 1m x 1m) placed on the ground to sample organisms within a defined area. It is used to estimate the number, distribution, or percentage cover of species, particularly plants and slow-moving animals.
